backend/main.mo: Main backend actor managing user profiles, AccessControl, and Stripe checkout/session logic with auto‑creation of user profiles.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module adding a nullable stripeConfiguration field while preserving existing userProfiles.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing various frontend utilities, pages, hooks, and components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables and base styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and still using the old CloutChem AI title.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Router setup with protected routes for dashboard and camera based on Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/components/ai/AICaptionGene: AI caption generator UI that builds captions client‑side with topic, tone, platform, and keyword inputs.
frontend/src/components/billing/StripeBu: Reusable component that loads the Stripe Buy Button script and renders the embedded checkout element.
frontend/src/components/billing/StripeCh: UI panel to view, edit, validate, and save Stripe checkout configuration stored in localStorage.
frontend/src/components/billing/UpgradeT: Displays upgrade options based on subscription tier and handles redirecting to Stripe checkout or using the Stripe Buy Button.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: App layout wrapper that loads the Stripe Buy Button script and renders header, footer, and routed content.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Footer displaying copyright, links, and a referral link with dynamic app identifier.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Header with navigation, authentication handling, and logout functionality tied to Internet Identity.
frontend/src/config/stripeCheckoutConfig: Utility module for reading, writing, validating, and checking Stripe checkout configuration in localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, auto-refetching dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Authentication context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and updating the caller's user profile through the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useStripeBuyButtonScr: Loads the Stripe Buy Button script once using a shared promise and exposes a hook for load status.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoRecorder.ts: Provides a hook for video recording with MediaRecorder, supporting start, stop, pause, resume, and clearing recordings.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/CameraPage.tsx: Camera and video recording page using custom camera and recorder hooks with UI for capturing photos and videos.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: User dashboard showing profile info, subscription status, tools, and refresh functionality.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Marketing landing page with hero content, features, and Stripe buy button support.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page using Internet Identity with UI for authentication and error handling.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentCancelPage.tsx: Displays a payment cancellation message with options to return to the dashboard or retry upgrade.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Shows a payment success confirmation and provides a button to navigate back to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/TermsPage.tsx: Renders the Terms of Service page with multiple sections detailing usage, licensing, accounts, and billing.
frontend/src/types/stripe-buy-button.d.t: Adds TypeScript definitions for the custom stripe-buy-button JSX element.
frontend/src/utils/captionGenerator.ts: Generates three caption suggestions based on topic, tone, platform, and keywords using templates, emojis, and CTAs.
frontend/src/utils/subscriptionTier.ts: Utility functions for converting and checking subscription tiers such as Free and Pro.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters with session persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Describes the CloudCam AI project state, existing features, requirements, and pending authentication work.
